fieldData.full-article-text:
There will be minimum stake amounts only to prevent spamming the network with miniscule stake amounts. Anyone holding XRD will be able to participate in delegating their stake to secure the network and receive incentive rewards.

We don’t expect there to be a maximum at this time.

fieldData.name: Are there minimum or maximum stake limits?
